verdict.rationale: Statsig documents Scheduled Rollouts, which let a Feature Gate deploy gradually over time on a schedule. That covers time-based release progression, but the evidence never says a user can set an arbitrary flag change to fire at a specific future date and time. Missing for 10: explicit scheduling of arbitrary flag or config changes at a chosen future time, detail on how scheduled rollouts are configured (start time, stages), API/CLI support for scheduling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
